report.summary: Install filters and the deterministic reconnect test are consistent with the code and spec at bfb05a8. The filtered set covers every import and script used by docs-only lint/format, check:versions, build:tempod and the tempod tests. The test now waits on observable reconnect entry instead of a 100 ms sleep. Spec tab 06 and CI.md are updated in the same change. Writes were refused in this environment, so neither the filtered install nor the Worker test was executed; one non-blocking note covers that.

findings.text: Not verified by execution: whether Bun 1.4.2 treats `--filter tempo` as the root package (name "tempo") and installs its devDependencies (oxlint, oxfmt, @oxlint/plugins, effect, turbo). Writes were refused here, so no filtered install was run. The playbook reports a local run (215 packages, then lint and format passed). If the root were left out, docs-only CI and the image workflow would fail visibly, not pass. To confirm: in a fresh copy run `bun install --frozen-lockfile --filter tempo`, then `bun run ci --docs-only`.

evidence.why: Correctness depends on how Bun's --filter handles the root package. It was not executed in this run. A wrong result would make CI fail, not pass silently.

checked.risk: Real contracts: Bun workspace filter install set vs. imports and scripts used by tempod tests, build:tempod, check:versions and the docs-only oxlint/anti-slop plugin

Failure paths: docs-only classification fails closed (unknown base runs the full suite with every workspace); playwright_version is only read on the code path, and every step that uses it is skipped for docs-only
Tests: removing the sleep, waiting on observable state, gate cleanup on failure, reconnect path through /v1/connect shared by the timer and op steps
Idempotency/state: connectTempod reuses one in-flight attempt, so the gate holds both the timer and step reconnects; kickQueue runs after hello
Build/runtime environment: Dockerfile.test user and owner unchanged (tempo, --chown); only the install filter changed; the image build and size check still run
Security: no secrets, credentials or ownership logic touched
Spec: build-plan tab and CI docs updated in the same change to describe the filtered installs
